text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Tucker Brine invited me
out mountain climbing!
She said it was "thanks for the drinks the other night."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Those drinks were supposed to be my thank-you to ya!
'Cept I ended up owin' ya one again!
So this is an extra layer of thanks, got it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a surprise, but climbing a mountain with her is bound to be a blast.
I arrived fully prepared and ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure you have a blast this time! Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Making great progress!
Today's route is perfect for leisure—you can soak
in all the forest bathing you could ever want.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Next, we take this path...
Huh? That sign...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: N-No through traffic, you say!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written on the hastily made sign
was a warning that a landslide had occurred on the road ahead
just a few hours ago.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Tch, totally unexpected!
Man, that's what makes Mother Nature
so damn thrilling!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tucker Brine calmly began to think without panic or fuss. Seeing her composure, I found myself entirely unsurprised. Knowing her, she surely...!
choice_data_list: Didn't you thoroughly research the other routes too?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, you saw right through me,
didn't you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'm talking about the wild and brilliant Miss Tucker!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
You sure hold me in high regard!
Yeah, you've got that right.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Truth is, if you double back a bit, there's another route with a much steeper incline.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: It's a bit too demanding for a human, so I was wondering what to do about it...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this! You'll be just fine!
You've been training alongside me this entire time!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOAAAH!
Give it everything you've gooot!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
That's some real grit!
Alright, follow me up the next rocky ridge!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Hup! Ho! Whoa...! That's a bit on the steep side, ain't it!
choice_data_list: I'll boost you up! Step on my hands!
I'll boost you up! Step on my hands!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
All right, leave it to me!
...Ready, set... and hup!
I maaaade iiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Take my hand!
Ready, set... GOOOOAAARGH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She pulled me up to the top with sheer strength, and beyond the difficult pass was—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Whewww!
We made it! The summit's riiiight here!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Spectacular view, isn't it?
This is what I wanted to show you!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Looks like this time I was finally able to repay the favor properly!
choice_data_list: You really didn't need to thank me in the first place, but...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: No! This is how I truly feel!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
You might think
it wasn't a big deal, but... it was.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
To me, it was this huge!
No, it was countless times bigger than that!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about me getting plastered
and needing a ride home.
...Just hear me out.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: THANK YOUUUU!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tucker Brine's words echoed back to us. Undeterred, she continued speaking.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
No matter how I look! ...That's right!
You really said that to meee!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
That struck deep! Right to the core!!
So you've got my thanksss!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Phew, phew...!
And I don't mean that as an exaggeration.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You're just like a kid!
Still, even if I'm not my usual self――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: You won't laugh, right?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Right on, pal!
Daha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She laughed freely and comfortably.
Seeing her open up like this
filled me with genuine happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so... I quietly took a deep breath as well.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Hm? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Haha!
Well look at that, your voice is even louder than mine!
choice_data_list: Thank you sooo much for the beautiful view!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Yelling feels freakin' great!
Alright, one more time for me—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Laughter echoed across the mountain peak.
It felt like Tucker Brine was flashing
a genuine, heartfelt smile too.
